params.body:
**Triage proposal** (from the forwarded mail; change the labels if it is wrong)
Category: bug  Priority: P2
Summary: A version with an ampersand arrives on the vehicle sheet as "Cool & Connect" instead of "Cool & Connect" after a chassis lookup. Every dealer has to clean the field by hand, and the wrong text travels on to the portals.

## What happens

While entering a Ford EcoSport, the field "Uitvoering" (`package`) was filled with `Cool & Connect`.

## Cause

The VWE chassis lookup (`OwnStockService::executeSOAPCall`) gets an XML answer whose content is a second XML document, escaped. The code turns `<` and `>` back into tags but leaves `&` as it is, so an `&` in the inner document (`&` there, `&amp;` on the wire) comes out as the literal text `&`. `convertVweJsonToVehicle` copies `SubModelName` into `package` as is. Answers are cached per chassis number in the VWE request table, so the cached ones carry the same text.

## Expected

The version reads `Cool & Connect`, also for an answer that was cached before the fix. Vehicles that already carry `&` in `package` are not corrected by the code change; that would be a separate one-off cleanup if wanted.

Source: Portal mail:22 (onboarding feedback, 2026-10-16).
params.title: Version from the VWE chassis lookup shows & instead of &
